issue: The generated relation combines independent `ascii_trim_start_index(seq)` and `ascii_trim_end_index(seq)` with `start <= end`. For any nonempty all-ASCII-whitespace input, the reviewed start boundary chooses `start == seq.len()` while the reviewed end boundary chooses `end == 0`, so the relation rejects the Rust body result `[]`.
proposed_relation: ascii_trim_source_body_result(seq, ret), where the end index is computed on `seq.subrange(ascii_trim_start_index(seq), seq.len())` to match `self.trim_ascii_start().trim_ascii_end()`.
